defects.description: PR-v3 missed this pose. Description says "Lean the back against a glass storefront" (backward arch / back-on-wall), but spine=14 is positive (forward fold per corrected convention). Should be spine negative (backward arch). Same pattern as PR-v3 fixes for back-wall-prop, car-lean, gate-lean.

regression_risk: low — single field change, only flips torso lean direction to match description
rationale: PR-v3 systematic spine-sign audit fixed back-wall-prop, car-lean, gate-lean (all with "back against" language) but missed glass-lean which has identical "Lean the back against a glass storefront" phrasing. Per CORRECTED convention spine +=forward, -=backward arch. Flipping 14→-14 to match back-against-wall backward arch. Sole field change. Foot-on-glass (leftFoot y=-0.503, z=+0.461 sole facing forward) and planted-foot (rightFoot y=-0.828) both already correct. Hip angle 3/4 view, neck tilt 10deg are preserved.
